english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for making, creating, cooking, or putting together something such as a plan.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for making or producing a practical thing, including creating a result from materials or ingredients.
This is the colloquial all-purpose verb for repairing things or preparing food and drink.
Use 整 for casually making or getting food ready, especially when the emphasis is preparation rather than a specific cooking method.
Use 整 for casually making, preparing, or cooking something for someone.

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for fixing or mending something in everyday speech.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for physically repairing a broken or damaged object.
Use this when the tinkering specifically involves physically repairing or adjusting an object, machine, or device.
